title: Smith Micro Joins the AgeTech Collaborative™ from AARP to Advance Family-Focused Technology for Aging in Place
summary: Smith Micro joined the AgeTech Collaborative to engage with organizations focused on supporting senior adults through technology-enabled solutions.
body_markdown:
**PITTSBURGH, PA, October 6, 2026** – Smith Micro Software, Inc. (Nasdaq: SMSI), a leading provider of software that simplifies and enhances mobile experiences, today announced it has joined the[AgeTech Collaborative™ from AARP](https://agetechcollaborative.org/) , a global ecosystem of organizations working together to improve how people age through innovation, research, and collaboration.


The AgeTech Collaborative brings together enterprises, startups, investors, service providers, and aging-focused organizations dedicated to accelerating technologies that help people live independently, safely, and confidently as they age. The collaborative provides opportunities to share expertise, explore partnerships, and bring innovative solutions to market that address the needs of older adults and their families.


Smith Micro joined the AgeTech Collaborative to engage with organizations focused on supporting senior adults through technology-enabled solutions. The company believes mobile devices play an increasingly important role in helping seniors remain connected, maintain independence, and access support when needed.


“The future of aging will be shaped by technologies that help people remain independent while strengthening family connections,” said Bill Smith, President, Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of Smith Micro. “The AgeTech Collaborative brings together organizations committed to solving real challenges facing senior adults and their families. We’re excited to expand our experience in connected mobile solutions to help create technologies alongside other innovators that make aging in place easier, safer, and more connected.”


Through innovations such as SafePath OS™ for Senior Phone and companion SafePath® caregiver applications, Smith Micro delivers connected experiences that help families stay informed, engaged, and connected without compromising independence. The company’s solutions are designed to maximize wireless connectivity and create a simplified bridge to independent senior living independently. SafePath provides family members and caregivers the tools they need to facilitate support, maintain rapport, and develop greater confidence and peace of mind for their loved one’s safety and well-being. Through partnerships with wireless operators, device manufacturers, service providers, and digital partners, these solutions help organizations deliver technology experiences that enable older adults to live independently while staying connected to family, caregivers, and support networks.


As the senior population continues to grow and technology becomes increasingly central to everyday life, organizations across multiple industries are seeking new ways to support healthy aging, caregiving, communication, and independence. Through participation in the AgeTech Collaborative, Smith Micro will connect with other leaders across the aging and technology sectors to explore opportunities that help address these challenges while creating innovative experiences for older adults and their families.


For more information about Smith Micro and its family-focused mobile technology solutions, visit[smithmicro.com](https://www.smithmicro.com/) .


**About Smith Micro Software, Inc.**


Smith Micro develops software to simplify and enhance the mobile experience, providing solutions to some of the leading wireless service providers around the world. From enabling Digital Family Lifestyle™ to providing powerful voice messaging capabilities, Smith Micro’s solutions enrich today’s connected lifestyles while creating new opportunities to engage consumers via smartphones and consumer IoT devices. For more information, visit[smithmicro.com](https://www.smithmicro.com/) .
